## Description

DQ issues grouped by type (e.g. "Glucose in mg/dL stored as mmol/L", missing DOB, invalid phone); a fix rule is defined once and applied to all matching rows, then the load re-runs; each fix is reversible and audited.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Fix-by-rule applies to all matching rows and records the rule, count and actor.
- [ ] **AC2.** Any rule application can be undone, restoring original values.
- [ ] **AC3.** Remaining issues are counted per type in the dry-run report.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
